item.title: Q3 financials: fee engines are carrying the quarter
item.description: BlackRock and State Street posted double-digit revenue growth on market-linked fees, while Bank of America and Wells Fargo show balance-sheet banks paying for compliance and building reserves.

item.title: September CPI: an energy shock, not a broad reacceleration
item.description: Headline inflation jumped to 3.7% on gasoline, while core held at 2.6%. The gap between the two is now the central question for the Fed on October 28.
